test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A rectangular piece of paper is 52 cm long and 22 cm wide. A cylinder is formed by rolling the paper along its breadth. Find the volume of the cylinder.[Take pi = 22over7 ]
solution:
**Given:**

Length & Width of the Rectangle is 52 cm & 22 cm respectively

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cylinder = π r² h, 

Circumference of a Circle = 2 π r

where r is radius and h is height

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8d5791728fd00655a64c8927cd576d7884337ae02e4d237117d982ed69f7e07.png] 

According to the question, 

Circumference of a cylinder = 2 π r

⇒ 22 = 2 π r

⇒ 22 = 2 × 22/7 × r

⇒ r = 7/2

Now the volume of a Cylinder = π r² h

⇒ 22/7 × 7/2 × 7/2 × 52

⇒ 2002

**∴ The volume of a Cylinder is 2002 cm²**
